reference_tables.intro: Listed below is all of the armor in the game, listed in the same order the game has them listed, which is the following order: - Male-equippable, weakest to strongest. - Female-equippable, weakest to strongest. - Character-specific best armor, in order of when the characters joined.

description.menu: Cotton Shirt. Rugged but easy to move around in.
description.text: A manly cotton shirt. Easy to move around in but very rugged. Real adventurers look great in simple designs.

description.menu: A vest made of tanned leather.
description.text: A vest made from the carefully tanned hide of a southern steer. Perfect for the male adventurer who swears by leather for battle. Don't get it wet.

description.menu: A harness studded with rivets.
description.text: A harness sold off by the special airborne troops of a certain country. A wonderful bargain. Too heave and big for women, but dangerously attractive when worn on bare skin by men.

description.menu: The ever-popular chainmail.
description.text: A chainmail vest for men. With its powerful defensive properties, it doesn't allow blades or bullets through. It may be plain, but one day you'll be glad you wore it.

description.menu: A red leather jacket for one hot dude.
description.title: Red Leather Jacket
description.text: Three times more expensive than the mass-produced kind, these jackets are all custom made. They are lined with rubber to absorb impact.

description.menu: Battle gear to challenge the toughest monsters.
description.text: A spiritual robe worn by warlocks when confronting evil. A bit costly, but offers excellent protection. Woven from superfine silk thread, it's light and has a unique sheen.

description.menu: A cute cotton blouse.
description.text: A plain white blouse, the image of female purity. Young ladies look quite sharp in them. Older women appear quite authoritative.

description.menu: A cool-looking leather skirt.
description.text: A pocketless leather miniskirt made from southern cowhide. It's easy to move around in, provides strong defense and looks great! A friend to fighting women everywhere.

description.menu: A bustier covered with glittering studs.
description.text: Chic, a studded bustier designed for defense as well as good looks. Although lightweight, it is still somewhat cumbersome to move around in.

description.menu: A beautiful, expensive silk bolero.
description.text: A bolero for the rich, active young lady. Made of the finest silk that has undergone a mystical process. Changes colors depending on how the light hits it.

description.menu: A blue cape that glitters faintly.
description.text: A tough cape of blue cloth, it reduces the chance of serious injury. Similar to the battle gear worn by the women of the Rose Croix on their journey to Rome.

description.menu: A robe with strong defense against evil spirits.
description.text: Holy robe worn by white witches during ceremonies to ward off evil, it is a powerful defense against envoys from the demonic world and is proof of high rank as a psychic medium.

description.menu: Coat well-suited to a destroyer of the gods.
description.text: A coat overflowing with supernatural power. Only those given the power to defy the gods can wear it. No one has yet been able to put it on. Cuts Darkness damage in half.

description.menu: The beloved coat Father used to wear.
description.text: Coat of legendary import in the Imperial Army. Worn by Colonel Ben Hyuga, known as "the God of Secret Intelligence". Cuts Darkness/Light damage in half.

description.menu: Rose embroidered with symbols of nobility.
description.title: Silver-Threaded Coat
description.text: A spiritual robe blessed by a holy woman. The velvet background is embroidered with ancient symbols. It has powerful defensive properties, and cuts Light damage in half.

description.menu: Robe with symbols of truth and suffering.
description.title: Gold-Threaded Coat
description.text: A long robe filled with the memories of martyrs past. The wearer feels as if he is wrapped in a warm light. Embroidered with ancient symbols, it cuts Light/Darkness damage in half.

description.menu: The short coat of a sage.
description.text: A sage's short coat, worn only by the highest-level Taoist Adepts. Those without spiritual power cannot touch it. Cuts Fire damage in half.

description.menu: A short coat woven by Qiuhua.
description.title: Coat of the Adept
description.text: A short coat woven by Qiuhua, with the soul of a young girl. "Sniff sniff...Oh, It smells like Shanghai". The wearer is filled with energy. Cuts Fire and Water damage in half.

description.menu: For adults only?
description.text: Suit make of thick rubber, its design is popular with "those" types. Originally a combat uniform for female members of a special assassination team. Cuts Water damage in half.

description.menu: For adults only!
description.text: Protective gear custom-made for the killer queen, Malkovich, who declared, "No Rubber Suit for me!" Cuts Fire and Water damage in half. "Not bad", she says.

description.menu: Proof of noble rank in the Darkness Clan.
description.title: Mantle of Nobility
description.text: A silk mantle that shows high rank in the Darkness Clan. Lined with the scalps of sacrificed clergymen, the wearer feels wrapped in night itself. Cuts Earth damage in half.

description.menu: A mantle stained by the blood of young virgins.
description.title: Mantle of Shivering
description.text: A hunting mantle worn by the Darkness Clan. The tears and blood of the young virgins that were their prey have made a complex patter in the lining. Cuts Earth/Wind damage in half.

description.menu: A jacket perfect for outlaws.
description.text: A leather jacket typically worn by street punks. The sharp metal spikes express their young rage. Reinforced with steel plates. Perfect for fighting. Cuts Wind damage in half.

description.menu: A soul-screaming jacket.
description.text: A jacket made of thin sheet of heavy metal. Causes multiple fracture wounds to enemies when hit with bare hand. It's heavy, but shout and bear it. Cuts Earth damage in half.
